messages.subject: tabsets: position on the left
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to align tabset titles on the left using the position argument

"he position of the tabs relative to the content. Valid
          values are "above", "below", "left", and "right" (defaults to
          "above"). Note that the ‘position’ argument is not valid when
          ‘type’ is "pill"."

This is my code

library(shiny)
server <- function(input, output) {
}
ui <- fluidPage( mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(position="left",tab="tabs",
         tabPanel("Plot", plotOutput("plot")),
         tabPanel("Summary", verbatimTextOutput("summary")),
         tabPanel("Table", tableOutput("table"))
       )
     )
)
shinyApp(ui, server)


However, the tab titles are at the top. Is this expected or am i misunderstanding  the position argument?

Cheers
Saptarshi

messages.subject: Re: tabsets: position on the left
parts: Yes, this is unfortunate. Bootstrap 3 has removed the ability to position tabs anywhere but "above" (a lot of other people have complained about this). See this stackoverflow post for ideas of getting around this using css. Because of this, we're about to deprecate the `position` argument to `tabsetPanel()` in Shiny. Sorry :(
